text:
pagerduty-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT triggered: metering.token-drift in prod-eu1 — severity: high. Pager -> #incidents, oncall rotation
alex: taking this. any immediate customer-facing alerts? link: https://redwood/alerts/1865432100
jamie: seeing surge in token counts from emitter-3, counts trending +120k above baseline in last 5m
billing-sre: confirmed. windowed-agg shows delayed batch commits; some windows are re-emitting earlier deltas. this looks like duplicate replays + delayed flush
alex: can you paste the query output
billing-sre: 
```SELECT window, sum(tokens) as tokens
FROM metering.agg
WHERE env='prod' AND region='eu1' AND ts > now() - interval '10 minutes'
GROUP BY window
ORDER BY window desc
-- last window: 245k (expected ~125k), previous: 10k
```
cs-ellen: we already have 2 customers who got overage email alerts. Logged ticket from AcmeCorp. They pinged CS.
sophie: putting on temporary suppress rule for auto overage emails for eu1 for 30m. need confirmation from billing-sre
billing-sre: yes go ahead. suppress rule: `billing.alerts.overage.suppress(region=eu1, duration=30m, reason="suspected duplicate emits")`
alex: what root cause hypothesis? delayed usage reports vs duplicate emitter replay?
billing-sre: initial theory: Kafka consumer group for emitter-3 fell behind, triggered manual retry, but retry path didn't deduplicate idempotently -> some batches re-ingested with new batch_id. combined with late windowing we count them twice.
jamie: logs show consumer lag spike at 02:11:25 UTC, followed by manual replay at 02:15:10 UTC
billing-sre: mitigation plan:
- pause emitter-3 replay job (already paused)
- start dedupe backfill for last 6 windows (run job: metering/dedupe-backfill --region eu1 --windows 6)
- silence automated overage emails (done by Sophie)
- notify customers about transient false overages via CS (Ellen)
alex: run the backfill now? estimate run time?
billing-sre: backfill queued. expected 12-18m. it will emit corrected deltas to reconciliation pipeline, then reports will reconcile and suppress will prevent email storms
cs-ellen: drafting a short customer note: "We're investigating spurious overage alerts in EU region — no invoice changes expected; we'll follow up shortly." Will send once you confirm
rachel: oncall handoff at 03:00 UTC — if this isn't stabilized, please escalate to 2nd level ops
alex: agree. i'll monitor for next 30m, then handoff to Rachel at 03:00
jamie: backfill job started: job_id=bf-1865432123
billing-sre: progress: processing window -3/6, duplicates identified: ~118k tokens, applying correction
sophie: suppress rule active. logs:
```
[SUCCESS] billing.alerts.overage.suppress applied region=eu1 ttl=30m
```
cs-ellen: customer note queued. sending after we see first reconciliation result
jamie: backfill completed at 1865432160, corrections pushed. reconciliation shows per-window counts now within expected variance
billing-sre: reconciled totals: before: +120k delta; after: +2k delta. looks good. running sanity checks on downstream billing export
alex: great. please keep monitoring exports to billing ledger for 10m. Rachel i'll handoff at 03:00 UTC (1865432280)
rachel: acknowledged. i'll take over monitor and incident follow-ups from 03:00
cs-ellen: sent customer note to affected accounts. will follow up with apology + confirm no invoice impact once final reconciliation done
sophie: reverting suppress at TTL expiry (30m) or earlier if we want; will coordinate with billing-sre
billing-sre: recommend leave suppress until billing export confirmed. will post update when billing ledger shows corrected snapshot
alex: summary for incident ticket INC-7142:
- trigger: metering.token-drift (eu1) due to consumer replay causing duplicate emits
- impact: transient overage alerts to small subset of customers, no confirmed invoiced charges (pending final billing export)
- mitigation: paused replay job, dedupe backfill, suppressed overage emails, customer notif sent
- owner: alex (oncall) -> handoff rachel at 03:00
sophie: :thumbsup:
rachel: I'll verify billing export and close incident once ledger stable. tagging follow-up: implement idempotent replay guard for emitter replays (prio P1)
alex: thanks team. leaving channel for handoff. 1865432165
